permissions.name: android.permission.SET_WALLPAPER
permissions.purpose: Apply the selected image as the home or lock-screen wallpaper through Android wallpaper APIs.
permissions.userAction: User taps an apply wallpaper action.
permissions.retention: No additional remote data; local wallpaper history follows the app's local storage policy.
permissions.deletionPath: Clear app data, remove favorites/downloads, or replace wallpaper through Android settings.
permissions.denialBehavior: Android blocks the apply action and Aura keeps browsing usable.
permissions.playDeclaration: Core personalization feature; no Play sensitive-permission declaration expected.

permissions.name: android.permission.WRITE_SETTINGS
permissions.purpose: Set selected sounds as ringtones, notification sounds, or alarm tones.
permissions.userAction: User grants system settings access and taps a sound apply action.
permissions.retention: Applied system sound URI remains in Android system settings until the user changes it.
permissions.deletionPath: Change the system sound in Android settings or remove the local downloaded sound.
permissions.denialBehavior: Aura shows that system settings permission is required before applying sounds.
permissions.playDeclaration: Sensitive special access; reviewed because it is required for ringtone/notification/alarm apply flows.

permissions.name: android.permission.RECORD_AUDIO
permissions.purpose: Record a community sound when the user explicitly starts recording.
permissions.userAction: User taps the record community sound action and grants microphone permission.
permissions.retention: Temporary recordings stay local until discarded or uploaded; uploaded community sounds follow the community deletion policy.
permissions.deletionPath: Discard the recording before upload, delete owned uploads where available, or use the account deletion request flow.
permissions.denialBehavior: Aura reports that microphone permission is required to record a community sound.
permissions.playDeclaration: Sensitive permission; user-initiated recording and upload flow.

permissions.name: android.permission.INTERNET
permissions.purpose: Fetch provider content, community data, optional generated wallpapers, and release-linked resources.
permissions.userAction: Browsing, provider search, community actions, or generated wallpaper requests.
permissions.retention: Provider and Firebase retention is documented in the privacy policy and provider runbooks.
permissions.deletionPath: Use provider controls, local cleanup, community deletion flow, or clear app data depending on feature.
permissions.denialBehavior: Offline/local content remains available where possible; remote features fail gracefully.
permissions.playDeclaration: Network access disclosed by provider and Data safety docs.

permissions.name: android.permission.ACCESS_NETWORK_STATE
permissions.purpose: Check connectivity before or during provider and worker operations.
permissions.userAction: Background or foreground network-dependent feature use.
permissions.retention: Connectivity status is not stored as user data.
permissions.denialBehavior: Network fallback checks are unavailable but core local browsing still works.

permissions.name: android.permission.WRITE_EXTERNAL_STORAGE
permissions.purpose: Support legacy Android downloads and file writes on API 28 and below.
permissions.userAction: User downloads or exports media on older Android versions.
permissions.retention: Downloaded/exported files remain where the user saves them.
permissions.deletionPath: Delete exported files through Android file managers or Aura download cleanup.
permissions.denialBehavior: Legacy external writes fail while scoped-storage paths remain available on newer Android.

permissions.name: android.permission.FOREGROUND_SERVICE
permissions.purpose: Run visible long-lived media or rotation work when enabled by the user.
permissions.userAction: User enables live wallpapers, media playback, or rotation triggers.
permissions.retention: Service state is transient; user preferences remain in DataStore.
permissions.deletionPath: Disable the feature or clear app data.
permissions.playDeclaration: Foreground service behavior must match Play foreground-service declarations.

permissions.name: android.permission.FOREGROUND_SERVICE_MEDIA_PLAYBACK
permissions.purpose: Keep audio/media playback controls alive while the user previews or plays sounds.
permissions.deletionPath: Stop playback or clear app data.
permissions.denialBehavior: Foreground media playback support is unavailable.

permissions.name: android.permission.FOREGROUND_SERVICE_SPECIAL_USE
permissions.purpose: Run the opt-in rotation trigger service for screen-off and unlock wallpaper rotation.
permissions.retention: Trigger preferences remain in DataStore until disabled or app data is cleared.
permissions.deletionPath: Disable rotation triggers or clear app data.
permissions.playDeclaration: Special-use foreground service; subtype documented in manifest.

permissions.name: android.permission.POST_NOTIFICATIONS
permissions.purpose: Show foreground service and worker notifications when Android requires user-visible status.
permissions.userAction: User grants notification permission when prompted by a feature that needs it.
permissions.retention: Notification permission state is managed by Android; Aura stores related feature preferences locally.
permissions.deletionPath: Disable notifications in Android settings or clear app data.
permissions.denialBehavior: Aura keeps the feature disabled or reduced when notification permission is required.
permissions.playDeclaration: Runtime notification permission for user-visible background work.

permissions.name: android.permission.ACCESS_COARSE_LOCATION
permissions.purpose: Fetch approximate weather for optional weather wallpaper effects.
permissions.userAction: User enables weather effects and grants approximate location.
permissions.retention: Last coarse coordinates and weather state are stored locally for the live wallpaper service.
permissions.deletionPath: Disable weather effects, revoke location permission, or clear app data.
permissions.denialBehavior: Weather effects skip location-backed updates and use non-weather visuals.
permissions.playDeclaration: Approximate location disclosure required for weather effects.

permissions.name: android.permission.WRITE_CONTACTS
permissions.purpose: Write the selected ringtone URI to the chosen contact.
permissions.userAction: User confirms assignment for a selected contact.
permissions.retention: The contact ringtone URI remains in Android Contacts until the user changes it.
permissions.deletionPath: Change the contact ringtone through Aura or Android Contacts/settings.
permissions.denialBehavior: Aura cannot assign the selected ringtone to the contact.
permissions.playDeclaration: Sensitive permission; targeted per-contact ringtone feature.

networkSurfaces.retention: Provider metadata can be cached for 24 hours and media can be cached offline by user action.
networkSurfaces.deletionPath: Clear caches, remove downloads, disable the provider, or clear app data.

networkSurfaces.userControl: Reddit source switch and subreddit settings.
networkSurfaces.retention: Returned image URLs can be cached in feed and offline media paths.
networkSurfaces.deletionPath: Clear caches, remove downloads, disable the provider, or clear app data.

networkSurfaces.userControl: Sound browsing controls and local cache cleanup.
networkSurfaces.retention: Returned preview URLs can be cached as favorites or offline sound media.
networkSurfaces.deletionPath: Remove favorites/downloads, clear caches, or clear app data.

networkSurfaces.userControl: Freesound API key controls and local sound cleanup.
networkSurfaces.retention: Returned previews can be cached as favorite or offline sound media.
networkSurfaces.deletionPath: Remove favorites/downloads, clear caches, clear the key, or clear app data.

networkSurfaces.userControl: SoundCloud client ID controls and local sound cleanup.
networkSurfaces.retention: Stream URLs can be cached as favorite or offline sound media.
networkSurfaces.deletionPath: Remove favorites/downloads, clear caches, clear the client ID, or clear app data.

networkSurfaces.userControl: Sound browsing controls and local cache cleanup.
networkSurfaces.retention: Returned stream URLs can be cached as favorite or offline sound media.
networkSurfaces.deletionPath: Remove favorites/downloads, clear caches, or clear app data.

networkSurfaces.userControl: Sound browsing controls and local cache cleanup.
networkSurfaces.retention: Returned download URLs can be cached as favorite or offline sound media.
networkSurfaces.deletionPath: Remove favorites/downloads, clear caches, or clear app data.

networkSurfaces.userControl: Weather effects toggle and Android location permission.
networkSurfaces.retention: Last coarse coordinates and weather state are stored locally for the live wallpaper service.
networkSurfaces.deletionPath: Disable weather effects, revoke location permission, or clear app data.

networkSurfaces.userControl: Generated wallpaper source switch, first-use disclosure, and Stability key controls.
networkSurfaces.retention: Generated image bytes are app-private and pruned to the most recent local outputs.
networkSurfaces.deletionPath: Remove generated favorites, clear generated files, clear the key, or clear app data.

networkSurfaces.userControl: YouTube source switch, sound query settings, and local cache cleanup.
networkSurfaces.retention: Resolved stream URLs are short-lived in memory and can be cached offline by user action.
networkSurfaces.deletionPath: Remove favorites/downloads, clear caches, disable the provider, or clear app data.

networkSurfaces.userControl: User chooses whether to import a collection link.
networkSurfaces.retention: No app-initiated network data is created by this endpoint row.
networkSurfaces.deletionPath: Delete imported collections or clear app data.

networkSurfaces.userControl: Community source switch, upload/report/delete flows, and account deletion request tools.
networkSurfaces.retention: Public upload metadata can remain public; private moderation, quota, report, and deletion evidence is retained for operator review.
networkSurfaces.deletionPath: Use owner delete actions, support deletion request flow, local cleanup, or clear app data depending on data type.

localStorageSurfaces.userControl: Settings provider-key Clear actions, feature switches, generated-content disclosure reset, or Android clear-app-data.
localStorageSurfaces.retention: Retained until the user changes the setting, clears the key/disclosure where available, or clears app data.
localStorageSurfaces.deletionPath: Use Settings controls for keys and toggles, or clear Aura app data.

localStorageSurfaces.userControl: Favorites, downloads, collections, history, export/import, and cache cleanup surfaces.
localStorageSurfaces.retention: Retained as user app state until the user deletes rows, clears caches/history, exports/imports replacements, or clears app data.
localStorageSurfaces.deletionPath: Remove favorites/downloads/collections/history where exposed, clear caches, or clear Aura app data.

localStorageSurfaces.userControl: Settings community identity surface can clear the local fallback identity; local hide state clears with app data.
localStorageSurfaces.retention: Retained locally until the user clears the fallback identity, removes app data, or uninstalls.
localStorageSurfaces.deletionPath: Use Settings > Community identity > Clear local for fallback identity, or clear Aura app data.

localStorageSurfaces.userControl: Change or clear selected content, remove widgets, clear wallpaper history, or clear app data.
localStorageSurfaces.retention: Retained locally to restore navigation and widget state until replaced or app data is cleared.
localStorageSurfaces.deletionPath: Change selections/widgets, clear history where exposed, or clear Aura app data.

localStorageSurfaces.storageLocation: shared_prefs/freevibe_live_wp.xml, shared_prefs/freevibe_weather_wp.xml, shared_prefs/freevibe_parallax.xml, files/live_wallpaper.*, and files/parallax/
localStorageSurfaces.userControl: Live wallpaper/video/weather/parallax settings, media replacement actions, and Android clear-app-data.
localStorageSurfaces.retention: Latest managed live wallpaper media and state persist until replaced, disabled, or app data is cleared; weather/live-wallpaper prefs are excluded from backup.
localStorageSurfaces.deletionPath: Replace or disable the live wallpaper feature, clear weather state, delete managed media by clearing app data, or uninstall.

localStorageSurfaces.userControl: Settings diagnostics bundle requires explicit Copy or Share action and redacts app-private paths and provider credentials.
localStorageSurfaces.retention: Crash log tail is capped locally and retained until app data is cleared or overwritten by newer crashes.
localStorageSurfaces.deletionPath: Clear Aura app data, or avoid sharing the diagnostics bundle.

localStorageSurfaces.userControl: Settings cache cleanup and Android clear-cache/app-data controls.
localStorageSurfaces.retention: Transient cache files are bounded by cache policies and can be deleted by the app or Android cache cleanup.
localStorageSurfaces.deletionPath: Use Settings cache cleanup, Android clear cache/app data, or uninstall.

localStorageSurfaces.userControl: Offline favorite cache actions, favorite removal, export/share surfaces, and Android clear-app-data.
localStorageSurfaces.retention: Offline files persist under a 512 MB total cache budget until removed, orphan-pruned, or app data is cleared.
localStorageSurfaces.deletionPath: Remove the favorite/offline copy, clear offline favorites, clear app data, or uninstall.

localStorageSurfaces.userControl: Generated wallpaper disclosure, generated source switch, favorite removal cleanup, and Android clear-app-data.
localStorageSurfaces.retention: Generated PNG files are capped to the most recent 50 outputs and saved generated favorites delete their app-private PNG after removal.
localStorageSurfaces.deletionPath: Remove generated favorites, clear app data, or uninstall.

localStorageSurfaces.userControl: Stop/cancel recording, discard before upload, upload with rights attestation, or clear cache/app data.
localStorageSurfaces.retention: Temporary recordings are deleted on cancel or failed short recording and otherwise remain cache-backed until uploaded or cache/app data is cleared.
localStorageSurfaces.deletionPath: Cancel/discard the recording, clear cache/app data, or uninstall.

localStorageSurfaces.userControl: User chooses export/share recipients and can clear cache/app data.
localStorageSurfaces.retention: Share artifacts are cache-backed temporary files retained until cache cleanup or app data is cleared.

localStorageSurfaces.userControl: Wi-Fi-only worker constraints, bundled sound browsing controls, local file cleanup by clearing app data.
localStorageSurfaces.retention: Verified Aura Originals files remain local after download so bundled sounds work offline.
localStorageSurfaces.deletionPath: Clear Aura app data or uninstall.

sdkSurfaces.userControl: Community source switch, account deletion request tools, and local fallback identity clear control.
sdkSurfaces.retention: Anonymous Firebase identity remains with Firebase until an owner-approved deletion workflow removes it; local fallback identity is app-private.
sdkSurfaces.deletionPath: Use the community account deletion request flow for Firebase identity and Settings > Community identity > Clear local for local fallback identity.
sdkSurfaces.playDeclaration: Disclose anonymous Firebase identity as community account/user ID data when community features are enabled.

sdkSurfaces.userControl: Community source switch, vote/report/block/profile/share actions, owner delete flows, and account deletion request tools.
sdkSurfaces.retention: Public and private RTDB rows follow the community deletion, moderation, quota, and retention policies.
sdkSurfaces.deletionPath: Use owner delete actions, account deletion request flow, support moderation routes, or clear local app data depending on row type.
sdkSurfaces.playDeclaration: Disclose community account, user-generated content, app interactions, reports, and public profile/share metadata.

sdkSurfaces.userControl: Explicit community upload, report attachment, owner delete, and account deletion request flows.
sdkSurfaces.retention: Committed upload objects remain in Firebase Storage until owner/admin deletion or account-deletion handling; temporary local files remain cache-backed before upload.
sdkSurfaces.deletionPath: Use owner delete actions, account deletion request flow, moderation support route, or operator upload execution receipt workflow.
sdkSurfaces.playDeclaration: Disclose community-uploaded media and report evidence as user-generated content handled by Firebase Storage.

sdkSurfaces.userControl: Community source switch, report/vote/follow/block/upload/profile actions, and account deletion request tools.
sdkSurfaces.retention: Callable request metadata is retained only through the backend community write, quota, dedupe, and moderation ledgers described in backend runbooks.
sdkSurfaces.deletionPath: Use owner delete actions, account deletion request flow, support moderation routes, or clear local app data depending on data type.
sdkSurfaces.playDeclaration: Disclose callable-backed community writes and quota metadata under community account, app interactions, and user-generated content.

sdkSurfaces.userControl: Community features can be disabled; debug tokens stay developer-only and are not release artifacts.
sdkSurfaces.retention: Firebase App Check and Play Integrity retain attestation evidence under provider policies; Aura does not store App Check tokens locally.
sdkSurfaces.deletionPath: Disable community features, uninstall Aura, or use provider/account controls where applicable.
sdkSurfaces.playDeclaration: Disclose Firebase App Check/Play Integrity service-provider processing for abuse prevention on Firebase-backed community features.

sdkSurfaces.userControl: Smart crop/parallax actions are user-selected and fall back to normal cropping if the unbundled model is unavailable.
sdkSurfaces.retention: Image processing is local to the device; Play services module delivery metadata follows Google Play services behavior and is not stored by Aura.
sdkSurfaces.deletionPath: Disable or replace parallax/live wallpaper content, clear app data, or uninstall.
sdkSurfaces.playDeclaration: Disclose Play services ML Kit/module-install dependency; Aura does not upload image bytes for subject segmentation.
